caption: The video captures a close-up of a single lit match held at an angle, its pale wooden stick pointing down-right against a featureless dark background. The match is already alight, a bright yellow-white flame climbing from the head while a small blue zone rings its base. The flame rises as a tall plume reaching the top edge, wrapped in a soft radial glow and a faint magenta lens halo. As the visible portion unfolds, the flame subsides into a shorter, steadier teardrop, its outline continuously flickering. The match head remains a golden-tan color throughout, while the blue zone at the base persists. The surrounding halo shifts in prominence, becoming a more diffuse magenta ring around the settling flame rather than a glow on the head. The stick's orientation stays roughly constant, so the motion is carried by the flame's changing height and flicker rather than any translation of the match.
